digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Ubuntu default CI cells (py3.11/3.12/3.13) consume 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run and drive queue contention

Bridge cadence test repeatedly parses workflow YAML 1,440 times inside a comprehension, wasting ~5.7 runner-minutes; hoisting YAML load eliminates redundant I/O while preserving exhaustive minute-check assertions

Pandoc render_unit test invokes real Pandoc for 232 units but asserts only existential cardinality; short-circuit evaluation with one subprocess preserves assertion while eliminating 231 redundant subprocesses
Static golden fixtures for legacy Pandoc conversion oracle eliminate 883 redundant subprocess invocations while retaining all 884 live product _convert assertions against real Pandoc

AST provenance fixture setup spends 48+ seconds discovering caller/parent relationships repeatedly; indexing once per process preserves all 24 (key, expr, verdict) tuples while eliminating redundant tree walks

Complexity-lock policy evaluation runs identically in every matrix cell (OS/Python invariant); executing once in lint job and deleting duplicates saves ~2.57 runner-minutes while preserving single evaluation per commit
